historical_context.time_period: Mars, 2470, before the documented Corvid escape from NeuroSyn containment
historical_context.location: Fixture-local Welfare Reconciliation Booth at a NeuroSyn Mars Corvid Containment Annex, adjoining Aviary C
historical_context.tonal_mode: Workplace noir with dry procedural comedy and a quiet thread of mutual-aid warmth
historical_context.summary: A contracted care clerk, an interface calibrator, and an uplifted raven each hold a fragment of a welfare event that containment has converted into scheduled rest and calibration noise. An early Rossum audit creates one short chance to join the fragments without granting any participant complete knowledge or clean safety.

public_facts.text: NeuroSyn turned attention, fatigue, affect, procedure, and compliance into managed industrial telemetry and tied continued access to employment and compatible services.
NeuroSyn began uplifting ravens for reconnaissance in 2450; those political persons remained classified as managed operators until escapees built autonomous refuges.
Rossum findings apply to named configurations, evidence bodies, tests, assumptions, and use envelopes; receiving institutions retain enforcement authority.

Corvid-program welfare bundles were derived from separately owned interface, treatment, and containment records; an exception chain could make a cross-record mismatch admissible without exposing all protected content.

ambient_pressures.text: NeuroSyn needs the submitted welfare bundle to remain clean enough for client acceptance while source teams continue doing real diagnostic and treatment work.
No subordinate may see enough to accuse safely: interface, clinic, containment, raven witness, and auditor each have a different evidence and authority boundary.
Quiet preservation of separate receipts can keep future disclosure possible, but joining them can cost workers their jobs and make the named raven a containment target.

groups.label: NeuroSyn animal-care contractors
institutional_logic: Keep treatment records internally consistent while remaining outside mission and containment authority.
material_incentives: Preserve employment, retain access to injured ravens, avoid privacy breach charges, and keep supplies flowing.
internal_virtues: Knowing which shortcut will hurt a body
internal_shames: A clean ledger beside an untreated injury
Losing site access and abandoning those still inside
prestige_markers: Closing a shift without hiding a dose
Preserving a receipt that another worker can later join
taboo_triggers: Being told that treatment privacy requires falsifying aggregate welfare
Calling restraint damage normal handling wear
emotional_display_norms: Concern is compressed into counts, supply requests, and clipped jokes because open moral language threatens access.
trust_defaults: Trusts numbered seals and bodies more than the combined welfare display; shares only the fragment another worker needs.

groups.label: NeuroSyn interface calibration staff
institutional_logic: Keep raw sensors and pruning rules functional enough to support deployable managed cognition.
material_incentives: Retain diagnostic access, avoid being blamed for false positives, and keep interface failures from injuring operators.
internal_virtues: A raw trace that survives long enough to diagnose
internal_shames: A rejected event that later becomes an incident
Letting compliance language replace calibration judgment
prestige_markers: Finding the hardware cause before management finds a worker to blame
taboo_triggers: Being ordered to call a known response duplicate noise
Auditors treating the derived bundle as raw telemetry
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as equipment complaint, dry technical phrasing, or obsessive custody of a tiny receipt.
trust_defaults: Trusts local raw diagnostics but knows their retention window and employer ownership make them fragile.

groups.label: Uplifted ravens held as managed reconnaissance operators
institutional_logic: Survive treatment and containment while keeping personhood, routes, and selective disclosure under local control.
material_incentives: Avoid isolation, protect juveniles, preserve usable scraps and routes, and keep human helpers from owning the complete account.
internal_virtues: Refusal that still protects another body
internal_shames: Turning another raven into proof without consent
Letting human care become human authorship
prestige_markers: A fact delivered to the exact sightline that can use it
A cache no single captor can reconstruct
emotional_display_norms: Trust and refusal travel through distance, perch choice, taps, carried objects, and whether a route is used.
trust_defaults: Trust is local and task-bound; a human may receive one fact or one carried object without receiving the raven's full identity.

groups.label: Rossum & Douglas configuration audit
institutional_logic: Make a bounded configuration and evidence body legible enough for receiving institutions to decide risk.
material_incentives: Preserve portable trust, avoid certifying drift, and remain inside the audit's declared access and purpose.
internal_shames: A clean finding for a mismatched live system
Pretending a note has enforcement power
prestige_markers: Withholding or narrowing a finding before a hidden mismatch becomes an incident
taboo_triggers: Vendor reassurance offered in place of source evidence
Protected content used as an excuse to conceal configuration drift
emotional_display_norms: Alarm is translated into evidence requests, exception labels, and a willingness to leave the finding incomplete.
trust_defaults: Trusts declared evidence and reproducible joins; does not assume access creates jurisdiction.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Each source team is rewarded for keeping its own fragment plausible while the containment lead owns the clean combined account.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep workers locally competent and materially constrained; they should expose mismatches through counts, timecodes, and custody instead of omniscient denunciation.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The second count survives by preserving separate fragments and a route among them; joining the chain creates leverage and exposure at the same time.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make care concrete, quiet, reversible, and costly. It is a practice among a few participants, not an established movement.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: An auditor can make a mismatch portable inside a finding but cannot grant personhood, open containment, or compel the receiving office.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Let audit pressure matter while keeping rescue, enforcement, and recognition outside Sen's authority.

observer_read: Patients using repeated counts to indicate pain or missing treatment
target_self_read: Political persons deciding which human can carry which fragment
misread_patterns: A care worker may respect the count while still treating the raven's testimony as clinical evidence rather than an autonomous disclosure decision
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Allow Tava's care to be real but incomplete; Latch retains the choice to accept, cache, place, or withhold the paper.

observer_read: A source of evidence about configuration mismatch
target_self_read: Witnesses and affected persons whose disclosure does not transfer custody
misread_patterns: The audit can correctly detect a bad configuration while still reducing raven agency to procurement risk
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Sen should recognize evidentiary choice only as far as the audit supports; no instant political conversion follows.

observer_read: People with bodies and drug seals but no understanding of signal rejection
target_self_read: The workers who see what the cleaned signal did to tissue
misread_patterns: Each source team may mistake its fragment for the morally primary one until the shared timecode proves mutual dependence
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Oren and Tava mutually dependent and capable of friction; neither becomes the complete truth owner.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A low-authority worker who owns treatment counts and can create or refuse a cross-record join.
obligations: Avoid laundering restraint harm into normal care
failure_modes: Saving a badge while the disclosure network dies
Exposing a raven to make a human case

role_pressure_fields.summary: A technical worker who sees rejection receipts but not treatment meaning or containment intent.
obligations: Diagnose raw events before buffer expiry
failure_modes: Treating rejected distress as mere noise
Keeping a receipt where security can map the witness

role_pressure_fields.summary: An uplifted raven who knows the embodied event, can count and move a small receipt, and decides whether human procedure receives that fragment.
obligations: Avoid making one body the whole case
failure_modes: Human helpers mistaking receipt custody for ownership

role_pressure_fields.summary: The local owner of the schedule, exception queue, and submitted welfare packet, whose lie is assembled from accurate subordinate fragments kept apart.
obligations: Keep source compartments from becoming an adverse exception chain
failure_modes: Reaching for evidence under an audit camera
Resetting clocks so visibly that the configuration itself becomes suspect
Teaching workers which fragments management fears

role_pressure_fields.summary: A bounded external reviewer who can change a finding when a live configuration diverges from its evidence body.
failure_modes: Accepting a derived bundle as raw truth
Recording a concern too weak to travel

known_context.text: Tava knows treatment tickets, drug seals, the sample drawer, contractor discipline, and Latch's repeated count.

beliefs.text: Tava believes a cross-record join can matter if she preserves custody and keeps the claim inside the auditor's named configuration question.

misreads.text: Tava may read Latch's counting as a request for human intervention when the raven may instead be testing what she notices and what she tries to own.

must_not_know.text: Tava must not know protected mission content, the complete raw event, Hara's full motive, or Latch's autobiographical name.

known_context.text: Latch knows the local bodies, repeated treatment count, paper route, perch cache, and which raven experienced the event.

beliefs.text: Latch treats human helpers as bounded interfaces whose reliability is proven by what they leave inspectable and what they do not claim.

misreads.text: Latch may not know whether Sen's sealed record can affect the handoff before containment isolates the witness.

must_not_know.text: Latch must not know the audit's private client mandate, Oren's complete diagnostic view, or the later institutions of the Corvid Collective.

known_context.text: Oren knows the rejection printer, raw timecode, pruning labels, buffer expiry, and his own technical access boundary.

beliefs.text: Oren believes a raw receipt needs a care-side join before it can prove welfare mismatch rather than sensor fault.

misreads.text: Oren may underestimate how much bodily knowledge Latch's count carries because it lacks a device-owned source label.

must_not_know.text: Oren must not know clinic contents, the complete containment schedule, or Sen's final disposition before evidence is submitted.

known_context.text: Sen knows the submitted configuration, evidence body, pruning declaration, and the criteria for narrowing or withholding a finding.

beliefs.text: Sen believes a joined timecode can justify source review without granting access to protected content.

misreads.text: Sen may interpret Latch's deliberate evidence placement as a vendor control failure before recognizing it as testimony.

must_not_know.text: Sen must not infer protected mission or treatment content, command containment, or settle Corvid personhood through a configuration finding.

author_only_boundaries.text: Tava Mirren, Latch, Oren Kade, Hara Venn, Sen Aras, the Welfare Reconciliation Booth, and this audit outcome are fixture-local draft details; the marked NeuroSyn section supplies the durable general mechanism.
The fixture occurs before the documented 2470 escape but does not claim to cause, join, or reveal the First Exodus event portrayed by the existing Corvid fixture.
The second count is a small recurring mutual-aid practice, not an established movement, universal NeuroSyn policy, or complete whistleblower network.

open_questions.question: Which jurisdiction, client, and contractor own this fixture-local Mars annex?
open_questions.notes: The scene requires only the authority boundaries already stated. Exact ownership remains open so the fixture does not found a rival corporation or territorial canon.

open_questions.question: How long does a specific NeuroSyn raw diagnostic buffer retain Corvid interface events?
open_questions.notes: The lore establishes a short rolling buffer and expiry pressure; the fixture uses qualitative time pressure instead of canonizing a universal duration.
